fit_reason: Despite the private seller label, this is dealer stock: the photos are taken in Unique Specialty & Classic Cars' showroom with dealer plates and banners, and the listing text says it is for sale by Unique Classic Cars.
findings: Silver paint looks clean and glossy on the hood, doors and rear deck in showroom lighting
Black wheels and tires look clean and dressed
Black soft top and seats look tidy in the exterior shots
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2020 Fiat 124 Spider Abarth. The silver paint and black wheels already look sharp in the photos. If you ever need a mobile detail or buff on any of your inventory, we'd be glad to give you a quote.
